correctness.rationale: For rank r, the principal downset has B_q(r)-1 elements; inclusion in the center line subtracts one additional nonzero subspace. Rank k birth is full geometric-lattice [1,k] selection. Standard EL-shellability concentrates free reduced homology in degree k-1, and Möbius inversion plus Gaussian recurrence computes rank q^{k(k+1)/2}[n-1 choose k]_q. At the earlier threshold for rank k+1 elements containing the center line, T -> T+L is an extensive order-preserving idempotent map with conical image, hence the full stage is contractible. All intermediate complexes are constant, giving exact integral persistence intervals. Five full prime-field cases were independently computed over three coefficient primes; computations are supplementary and do not replace the arbitrary prime-power proof.

value.rationale: This supplies an all-prime-power, all-dimension exact persistent invariant for the natural poset of projective flags, extending finite-space furtherness beyond degree-zero and Boolean distributive cases. It proves no overlap of positive-dimensional homology bursts and a strict one-step gap between successive degrees; exact Gaussian multiplicities, nonbinary subspace-count endpoints and integral splitting are motivated features needed for projective-subspace benchmark calculations. The result rests on nontrivial shellability and closure-operator topology, not a reparameterization or an arbitrary small finite count.
